sections.title: Synopsis
sections.markdown: A hybrid DPS+Support that deals most of her damage by accumulating damage dealt by the rest of the team and repeating a portion of it as fixed damage. OTs-14 won't carry a team by herself as a result but is instead a damage amplifier, multiplying the team's overall damage output. This basically earns her a slot on any team for the foreseeable future. At V6, she can add tile generation to any elemental team.

sections.title: Team notes
sections.markdown: Basically a staple in every team. Note that a majority of the team needs to be the same element to activate each Reconfiguration effect, so the composition becomes 3 element core + OTs-14 + flex.

sections.title: Build notes
sections.markdown: Find sources for increased fixed damage dealt - OTs-14's common key is a must. Otherwise, her personal damage is all active + AoE + Resonance and the majority is basic attack. For Resonance damage scaling, use any elemental boosts (excluding Physical) or general phase damage boosts.
